titleEn: Orders app (orders.ebda.app) and new-order alert sound/push on phone

ar: ازاي يرن الموبايل لما ييجي اوردر؟
en: How do I get a sound alert for new orders?

steps: Enable order alerts button (EnableOrderAlertsButton) in the admin; install orders PWA.
edgeCases: iOS push requires Add to Home Screen
Browser permission denied: must re-enable in settings
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Plan/feature not allowing it: API returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with an upgrade target when the plan is the cause; assistant must name the plan and link Billing, never imply a toggle
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Team member lacking the permission gets 403: assistant states who can do it (store owner) instead of retrying
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
